description: Two new full-stack implementation assignments and two new full-stack maintenance assignments, frozen after checker-transport validation and before stack scaffolds, reference implementations, protocol thresholds, or measured agent output.

common_contract.server: Expose the exact GET status route and typed POST JSON route declared by the task. Reject malformed JSON, missing fields, unknown fields, wrong field types, and out-of-domain numeric values. A number is a JSON integer and never a boolean; yesno is a JSON boolean.
common_contract.errors: Return status 400 with {"error":"invalid_json"} for invalid JSON shape, types, or values. Return status 415 with {"error":"json_content_type_required"} for a POST body without application/json. Return status 413 with {"error":"body_too_large"} when the request body exceeds the frozen limit.
common_contract.browser: Expose the declared deterministic scalar browser function as an ES module export and return the exact frozen values in real Chromium.
common_contract.cross_target: The response field named by shared_result_field must equal the browser export for equivalent inputs.
common_contract.network: Bind only to 127.0.0.1 on the harness-selected port.
common_contract.numeric_domain: All numeric inputs are nonnegative integers. timeline_bucket_repair additionally requires bucket_seconds to be at least 1.

tasks.title: Build a rail connection evaluator across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Rail Connection contract in the supplied stack. Transfer buffer is 7 minutes when platform_change is true and 3 minutes otherwise. ready_minute is arrival_minute + delay_minutes + transfer buffer. margin_minutes is departure_minute - ready_minute. wait_minutes is max(margin_minutes, 0). outcome is make when margin_minutes is at least zero and miss otherwise. The browser export returns margin_minutes.
tasks.independence: New rail domain, routes, vocabulary, branching rule, field set, fixtures, and browser export, selected before any 037 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Build an orchard irrigation scheduler across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Implement the frozen Orchard Irrigation contract in the supplied stack. raw_liters is dryness_points * tree_rows * 2. rain_credit_liters is tree_rows * 5 when rain_expected is true and zero otherwise. scheduled_liters is max(raw_liters - rain_credit_liters, 0). pump_cycles is scheduled_liters divided into 40-liter cycles using ceiling division, with zero scheduled liters producing zero cycles. mode is idle when scheduled_liters is zero and active otherwise. The browser export returns pump_cycles.
tasks.independence: New irrigation domain, routes, vocabulary, ceiling rule, field set, fixtures, and browser export, selected before any 037 scaffold or model output.

tasks.title: Repair tiered usage points across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Tiered Meter application. standard_units is min(consumed_units, included_units). excess_units is max(consumed_units - included_units, 0). excess_rate is 7 during a peak_window and 4 otherwise. usage_points is standard_units * 2 + excess_units * excess_rate. band is included when excess_units is zero and excess otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns usage_points.
tasks.predeclared_defect: When excess usage exists, the application-logic module applies the excess rate to every consumed unit instead of preserving the two-point included tier.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The defect mechanism, source, names, formula, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected before any measured output.

tasks.title: Repair exact-boundary timeline bucketing across HTTP and browser targets
tasks.statement: Repair the supplied Timeline Bucket application. offset_seconds is max(timestamp_second - origin_second, 0). bucket_index is offset_seconds divided by bucket_seconds using floor division. bucket_start_second is origin_second + bucket_index * bucket_seconds. position_second is offset_seconds - bucket_index * bucket_seconds. location is boundary when position_second is zero and inside otherwise. The HTTP response and browser export must use the same rule; the browser export returns bucket_index.
tasks.predeclared_defect: The application-logic module increments bucket_index when position_second is zero, assigning exact-boundary events to the following bucket.
tasks.adaptation_boundary: The defect mechanism, source, names, formula, fixtures, and expected repair are new and were selected before any measured output.
